summaryZh: Yong Lab 研究化学反应中分子系统的超快动态，旨在理解激发态过程并控制分子尺度能量与电荷流动。技术包括超快 X 射线/电子散射、激光光谱以及理论计算光谱和量子化学。

evidence.quote: The Yong Lab @ UC San Diego
Our goal is to build an accurate, fundamenatal understanding of excited-state physical and chemical processes, enabling precise control of the flow of energy and charge at the molecular level.
Ultrafast X-ray/Electron Scattering Ultrafast Laser Spectroscopy Theoretical Chemistry Theoretical/Computational Spectroscopy Quantum Chemistry
